source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of urinary tract infections (PDF 19).

blocks.text: Urinary tract infections (UTIs) aam taur par bacteria se hoti hain, sab se zyada Escherichia coli se. Bacteria urethra ke raaste peshab ke nizam mein dakhil ho kar bladder, ureters ya gurdon ko infect karte hain.

blocks.caption: Urinary tract infection
rows: bacteria, aksar Escherichia coli, jo urethra se dakhil hote hain
baar baar aur fauran peshab ki hajat; peshab mein dard ya jalan; dhundla ya tez boo wala peshab; pait ke nichle hisse mein dard; kabhi bukhar ya kapkapi
bacteria marne ke liye antibiotics ka course; zyada pani peena aur aksar peshab karna unhein baha dene aur alamaat kam karne mein madad dete hain

blocks.prompt: UTI mein zyada pani peena kyun madad deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Zyada pani se zyada peshab aur baar baar peshab hota hai, jo antibiotics ke saath bacteria ko peshab ki nali se baha deta hai.

items: UTI: bacteria (zyada tar E. coli) urethra ke raaste; hajat, jalan, dhundla peshab; antibiotics aur zyada pani.
